author: Inside Edition
description: There was a beehive of activity at Madison Square Garden just two days from Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce's wedding. The street in midtown Manhattan was packed with delivery trucks as workers unloaded equipment and props. Inside Edition spotted security teams using mirrors to check beneath vehicles for explosives and weapons. According to published reports, Swift and Kelce are demanding that all their guests sign a non-disclosure agreement.
title: Equipment And Props For Taylor Swift And Travis Kelce's Wedding Spotted Being Unloaded From Trucks

author: Inside Edition
description: It was a race against the clock as first responders tried to get people out of a car that went into a pond. When the car started sinking, they knew more resources were needed to help. Rescuers in Fairfax County, Virginia went into the water to assist others. While some of the car's occupants were able to get out on their own, one person seemed to be trapped. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: Rescuers Form Human Chain To Rescue Woman Trapped In Car In Pond

author: Inside Edition
description: It was a close encounter of the bear kind, and it was all caught on a home's surveillance camera. A man was going about his business outside a home in Steamboat Springs, Colorado. But when he opened the door to his truck, he was shocked to find a little black bear riding shotgun. The understandably startled man jumped back, and took a few cellphone photos, before trying to remove the bear from his front seat.
title: Little Black Bear Climbs Into Truck And Startles Man In Colorado

author: Inside Edition
description: Glenn Sperry, 85, says when he was asked to create structures for waterskiing stunts, he wasn't going to sit around and watch others use them. According to WSAW, that was 58 years ago and time hasn't seemed to stop Sperry, or even slow him down. As you can see, he can ski, jump, and spin all out on the water in Wisconsin. He's developed a fanbase that looks forward to watching him. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: 85-Year-Old Impresses Crowds With Water Skiing Skills
